body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Reigncom(www.reigncom.com) launches its latest portable media player 'iriver Spinn' adopting a new analog 'Spinn Wheel', which combines warmth of analog controls with digital content.

Featuring a 3.3-inch AMOLED touchscreen with 480*272 resolution and haptic feedback feature, it supports various music formats including MP3, WMA, OGG, FLAC and ASF as well as video formats including MPEG4, WM9 and WMA.

It also boasts 24-hour audio lifespan and comes in a metal and plastic casing that is just 0.42-inches thick. Other features of the iriver Spinn include a FM radio, flash game, Bluetooth 2.0, photo/text viewer, voice recording T-DMB, and video playback at 30 fps.
The iriver Spinn is now available for pre-order in Korea with an suggested retail of 259,000(KRW) for the 4GB model and 299,000(KRW) for the 8GB model.
